research.scope: P3 4.04.3 full typed predicate compile/eval and three-valued logic; no product edits until D2/fixture freeze.

observations.finding: AND records any NULL and chooses false if a false term is present, otherwise NULL if any term is unknown.
observations.adopt: Explicit three-valued Truth semantics; FALSE dominates AND while UNKNOWN is retained.
observations.reject: No VM instruction stream or short-circuit machinery copied; initial XADB evaluator is eager after complete validation.

observations.finding: OR records NULL, true dominates; NOT preserves the separate null flag.
observations.adopt: OR/NOT truth semantics and clear distinction between boolean payload and unknownness.
observations.reject: XADB uses a separate TruthValue enum, not Datum null/value flags or scalar Bool as a predicate result.

observations.finding: External parameter runtime ptype is checked against prepared expected paramtype before consuming value/isnull.
observations.adopt: Check original parameter type including typed NULL before normalization/evaluation.
observations.reject: Runtime provider hooks and engine expression contexts are outside the pure borrowed API.

observations.finding: Unknown parameter slots retain an unknown type until a coercion context is found.
observations.adopt: Keep unresolved markers distinct from raw NULL and concrete ScalarType.
observations.reject: XADB occurrence ordinals are unique and capped256; no arbitrary parameter array growth or repeated variable unification.

observations.finding: A target type resolves an unknown parameter; incompatible already-resolved type is diagnosed.
observations.adopt: Use concrete peer/hint inference and reject incompatible hints.
observations.reject: Do not adopt general coercions, OIDs or catalog type resolution.

observations.finding: A separate post-analysis tree walk verifies parameter resolution.
observations.adopt: Finish all concrete type checks before a separate ordinal-order unknown-marker rejection phase.
observations.reject: No recursive query walk or subquery semantics introduced.

observations.finding: All BoolExpr arguments are transformed and coerced before the semantic expression is returned.
observations.adopt: Whole-tree name/type validation cannot be skipped by a true/false/NULL branch.
observations.reject: Implicit boolean coercion remains unsupported in XADB.

observations.finding: C collation compares common byte prefix and then lengths.
observations.adopt: Unsigned byte lexicographic semantics, with prefix length tie-break and no padding.
observations.reject: Whole payload memcmp lacks XADB CallControl checkpoints; locale/collation branches are outside current SQL semantics.

observations.finding: AND/OR use explicit three-state truth tables and preserve NULL output.
observations.adopt: Cross-check independent SQL 3VL semantics and mandatory21-cell acceptance inventory.
observations.reject: Do not copy the table into the product oracle; oracle uses independently frozen literal truth values. SQLite truth coercion is not XADB Bool typing.

observations.finding: NOT yields NULL when input is NULL and otherwise complements boolean truth.
observations.reject: No dynamic Mem coercion or VM register model.

observations.finding: sqlite3MemCompare makes NULL lower than non-NULL and equal to NULL.
observations.adopt: Evidence that key/total order must be separated from SQL predicate null comparison.
observations.reject: Never use NULL total-order equality for XADB ordinary comparison; it must return Unknown.

observations.finding: Comparison supports numeric mixed kinds and text/blob category ordering/collations.
observations.reject: XADB rejects cross-type comparisons and uses strict Int64/Bool/Utf8/Binary; no numeric coercion or type-tag sort order.

xadb_api_findings.finding: OwnedScalar is nonClone with borrowed as_ref. ScalarReader decode consumes actual immutable AST and validates raw values. ScalarRef type/length helpers are private. Fault state/count resets per decode call.
xadb_api_findings.application: Reuse decode only after complete static passes; compiler aggregates test-support allocation ordinals through remaining target and actual reached sites; eval borrows existing ScalarRef views.

xadb_api_findings.finding: Scalar backing reserves session then DB and charges observed allocator excess before publication. Data field drops before leases.
xadb_api_findings.application: Preserve original scalar implementation and diagnostics; typed owner uses same shared-ledger invariants for fixed exact arenas.

xadb_api_findings.finding: ChargedVec carries Parse module/injection scope and source/AstNode ownership assumptions.
xadb_api_findings.application: Do not directly reuse it with wrong module/whole-compile ordinal; a local exact typed budget is the proposed narrow new consumer, not a foundation/general budget refactor.

xadb_api_findings.finding: Name has private fixed bytes and no Clone; as_bytes identity ignores source span/quoted flag.
xadb_api_findings.application: ColumnSpec borrows validated Name; compiled metadata makes bounded canonical copy, and external metadata diagnostics use point0 rather than Name.span from another source.

xadb_api_findings.finding: Value owns payload, Null is untyped, compare handles NULL before type discrimination and delegates variable data comparison to Ord.
xadb_api_findings.application: Foundation remains unchanged. SQL-local borrowed comparator is necessary for typed NULL/full tag validation, no allocation, and cooperative byte checkpoints.
